name: Poojaa Precision Engg. Limited
summary: Poojaa Precision Engg. Limited, a precision engineering company, manufactures and sells aluminium and machined components in India. The company offers auto components, including air intake elbows and pipes; alloy wheel; alternator brackets; bearing frame; housings; cylinder head; intake manifolds; oil cooler cover; rocker arm; and timing cover. It also provides non-auto components, including agri sector, circuit breaker, compressor pistons, gas insulator conductors, gas insulator flanges, gear box housing, and xray machine, as well as transmission casings.
